current.text: Minnesota traded Julius Randle and Naz Reid and added LaMelo Ball. Coach Chris Finch said the team did Edwards a disservice by playing him on the ball so much.
With Ball on the team, Edwards should play more off the ball. Expect fewer assists and more catch-and-shoot threes. Both players should be able to keep their three-point volume.

Experts disagree on what Ball means for his scoring. One expects his points to drop to about 27. Another expects better efficiency and possibly more defense now that Ball takes some of the offensive load.
He is projected for about 31% usage and 35 minutes.
Experts rank him about 7th to 10th in 9-cat. He is fine at pick 8 to 10 but too expensive at pick 5 to 7. A Yahoo ADP of 17 is far too late for him.
Josh values him at 40 USD or more in an auction.
He went for 45 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Minnesota has a two-game week starting March 15. That is week 20, in the middle of our fantasy playoffs.
Because of the two-game playoff week, move him down slightly on your board when the call is close.
Minnesota is expected to compete for a playoff spot and should not rest players to tank. One expert predicts 53 wins.
Minnesota has a thin bench with little scoring punch, so the starters carry a heavy load.

durable.text: He is a high-volume scorer and three-point shooter. Points and threes are his standout categories.
He shoots threes at high volume at around 40%. Two years ago he was the best catch-and-shoot shooter in the NBA.
He commits a lot of turnovers, and his turnover numbers have stayed fairly flat. TO is his clear weak category.
His assist rate has fallen in each of the last three seasons.
He had a reputation for never missing games. Last season he missed enough games that he did not qualify for All-NBA.
He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues. Experts put him in tier 2 for categories and tier 3 for points.

note: The market prices him at about 52 to 60 USD (Yahoo average cost 59.4, ESPN 59.8, 55 USD in our league last season). Experts value him closer to 40 to 45 USD, and the two-game playoff week is another reason to stop bidding before he reaches 59 USD. His elite points and threes with high turnovers fit punt TO builds best. Early in the season, check whether his assists and usage drop next to LaMelo Ball and whether his catch-and-shoot threes go up.
